en: An old, colorized postcard showing a public square with a fountain or monument at its center. There are several leafless trees and groups of people, including children, gathered in the square. The architecture is European, with a three-story building featuring balconies to the right and a lower building in the background. The text 'Vigo - Plaza de la Princesa' is printed at the top. A blue library stamp from 'Biblioteca Pública de Pontevedra' is visible in the upper left corner.
